description: Trello is a web-based project and task management service organized around boards, lists, and cards. It is part of Atlassian and is used to track work, collaborate, and automate workflows.
summary: Trello exposes a REST API at `https://trello.com/1`; docs show the classic `key` + user `token` query-parameter auth, and Trello also documents OAuth 2.0 client configuration for accessing the same API. No Trello-owned GraphQL API, MCP server, or standalone CLI was found on trello.com.
